## Required delivery

- Delivery directory: `delivery/<batch-name>/` (or N/A with rationale):
- Change classification: frontend / backend-design / both / neither (explain):
- Frontend: `before.png`, `after.png`, `screenshots.md` (same scenario/viewport, fixture or command): paths or N/A with rationale:
- [ ] Motion, transition, scrolling, gesture, loading or response delivery: GIF/video path, fps, duration, viewport, recording method and whether actual playback was recorded; file size and MP4 explanation if over 10 MB. If unavailable, explain and request alternative acceptance; stills alone do not suffice. N/A with rationale for static-only changes.
- Backend/design: `changes.md`, `state-machine.md`, `behavior.md`: paths or N/A with rationale:
- Completeness, privacy and semantic review attestation (include gaps):
